Borrow this pattern from William Shakespeare: "Yet your position leaves the strongest counter-example untouched. When the measured results are compared across studies, then the pattern i…" — it answered the opponent directly, its premises led cleanly to the conclusion.

Your weakest move against William Shakespeare was "I just feel a four-day week keeps output and improves lives, that is all." (soundness 0.65). State its premises and evidence before you use it again.
